pedal: Boss RV-6 Reverb — focused session, six modes (stereo: Input A -> Outputs A and B; Input B and EXP empty)
comment: Modulate, Spring, Plate, Hall, Room and Shimmer (Dynamic and +Delay left out), every one at every setting: the three knobs are set once per block and only Mode turns from take to take (the user, 2026-11-15: easier, and a Mode change clears the tail), up the dial in one block and down it in the next. A take is several signals one after another (a sequence), each followed by silence as long as that mode's tail at that Time: a -24 dB sweep (the response: start, decay per band, colour, the two outputs), a 50 ms noise burst (the tail's density and modulation; October's signal), in Modulate and Shimmer a held note (the pitch's wander, the octaves), and the guitar (captures/di/ stabs at full level: the model against the pedal on playing). Blocks: everything at 12:00 (bursts at -24/-12/0 dB: is the wet linear?; then stabs, chords, the lead, quiet funk); Time at its four other positions; Tone at its four other positions; Tone's ends at Time's ends (does Tone act after the tank in every mode?); E.Level at 9:00, 3:00 and 5:00; two settings with all three knobs off 12:00, kept out of every fit; the first block again at the end. The marker goes to the loopback only (no marker in the tail). Clock positions: 7:00 = fully counter-clockwise, 5:00 = fully clockwise; 9:00 and 3:00 pointer horizontal. Blocks ordered so each turns one or two knobs.

takes.name: bypass-sweep
takes.note: The pedal off (its LED off): the bypass reference. OUTPUT A on input 2, OUTPUT B on input 1, INPUT A only, the adapter (not a battery).

takes.name: level-0700-hall
takes.note: The pedal on (its LED lit), E.LEVEL fully counter-clockwise: the dry alone through the effect's path.

takes.name: noon-modulate
takes.note: Everything at 12:00. From here on: set the three knobs once per block, then only MODE turns from take to take (it also clears the last take's tail).

takes.name: noon-guitar-shimmer
takes.note: Same knobs, the guitar: MODE back the other way.

takes.name: time-0300-modulate
takes.note: TIME to 3:00.

takes.name: time-0500-shimmer
takes.note: TIME fully clockwise. Long tails: Shimmer's take runs over two minutes.

takes.name: tone-0700-time-0500-modulate
takes.note: TONE fully counter-clockwise, TIME stays at 5:00.

takes.name: tone-0500-time-0500-shimmer
takes.note: TONE fully clockwise.

takes.name: tone-0500-time-0700-modulate
takes.note: TIME fully counter-clockwise, TONE stays at 5:00. Short takes now.

takes.name: tone-0700-time-0700-shimmer
takes.note: TONE fully counter-clockwise.

takes.name: time-0700-modulate
takes.note: TONE back to 12:00.

takes.name: time-0900-shimmer
takes.note: TIME to 9:00.

takes.name: tone-0900-modulate
takes.note: TIME back to 12:00, TONE to 9:00.

takes.name: tone-0700-shimmer
takes.note: TONE fully counter-clockwise.

takes.name: tone-0300-modulate
takes.note: TONE to 3:00.

takes.name: tone-0500-shimmer
takes.note: TONE fully clockwise.

takes.name: level-0500-modulate
takes.note: TONE back to 12:00, E.LEVEL fully clockwise: the loudest the reverb gets. If the tool says an input clipped, tell me rather than turning the interface down mid-session.

takes.name: level-0300-shimmer
takes.note: E.LEVEL to 3:00.

takes.name: check-a-modulate
takes.note: A setting kept out of every fit: E.LEVEL stays at 3:00, TONE 9:00, TIME 3:00.

takes.name: check-b-shimmer
takes.note: The other one: E.LEVEL 9:00, TONE 3:00, TIME 9:00.

takes.name: level-0900-modulate
takes.note: TONE and TIME back to 12:00, E.LEVEL stays at 9:00.

takes.name: again-shimmer
takes.note: Everything back to 12:00: the first block again, the pedal against itself an hour on.
